assessment: This article addresses the mechanism of ligand specificity of odorant receptors (OR) through mutational analyses and structure prediction. Through solid data, the authors identify a single amino acid substitution that switches ligand specificity between two olfactory receptors. Obtaining structures of OR complexes has been challenging, so such an approach is valuable and will be of interest to scientists within the fields of chemical ecology and sensory neuroscience.
